definitions.explanation: A decorative pattern featuring flowers or floral motifs, commonly found on fabric, clothing, tableware, and other surfaces.

examples.japanese: {花柄|はながら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{花柄|はながら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食器|しょっき}→食器：04204_shokki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: My mother likes tableware with floral patterns.
When spring comes, you see more people wearing clothes with floral patterns.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧ (flower) and ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ (pattern; design on fabric). The ⟦{柄|がら}→柄：02609_gara⟧ element is productive and appears in many pattern-describing compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {花柄|はながら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ワンピース→ワンピース：04526_wanpiisu⟧: floral-print dress
- {花柄|はながら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧: floral-print curtains
- {花柄|はながら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧: floral wallpaper
- ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧{花柄|はながら}: small floral print
- {大|おお}{花柄|はながら}: large floral print
